limitations: Only actual model responses with completed nonempty frozen-window truth enter semantic denominators.
HTTP no-response, eligible unrun, and transfer-ineligible documents are excluded rather than model false negatives.
UNVERIFIED and AMBIGUOUS event fields are excluded; frozen evaluator UNKNOWN is not correct absence or a true negative.
Frozen literal/alias matching can leave a source-stated short or long product expression unmapped; unmatched counts are not proof of semantic falsity.
Adopted recall measures the source-validation/adoption pipeline and is separate from raw-response semantic recall.
Raw semantic scores bind context only and do not override failed entity/fact source validation or adopt rejected responses.
CPU comparison covers product entity extraction only on common response-and-review inputs; role and actuality are unsupported.
No full-document, fifty-document, human-validated, or leading-performance claim is supported.

Gold sessions report out-of-scope session-status metadata exposure; no evaluated extraction values or other gold answers are reported exposed, but strict source-only procedural isolation is not pristine.
